capabilities: Pin a note to the top of its folder via the context menu or command palette
Reorder pinned notes above or below other pins
Unpin notes so they return to their normal sort position
Show a pin icon on pinned notes matching the theme colors
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Pin state is stored in the plugin's own data file, not in notes, filenames, or frontmatter; moving a note to another folder unpins it.
motivation: The README's tagline 'no more renaming files to AAA-note to force them to the top' states the pain it was built to remove.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer sorts notes uniformly, so keeping important notes at the top of a folder requires renaming tricks like an AAA- prefix.
summary: File-explorer plugin that pins notes to the top of their folder with custom ordering, replacing renaming hacks.
